about_the_game:
Goblin Hunter is a retro dark fantasy action game where you tactically hunt goblins using light, shadow, sound, and environmental traps. Forge bonds with scarred townsfolk, rebuild your village against goblin hordes, and conquer the protagonist's inner demons through choices.

This demo version includes:

  • Combat Arena: Showcases full combat capabilities, allowing players to experience non-stealth combat intensity

  • Complete Sewer Level: Full stealth-focused gameplay sequence

  • Incomplete Art Assets: Partial visual effects marked as "WIP" (to be updated)

  • Future updates will add more demo content
    Excludes: Main storyline & town quests (combat gameplay only)

content_descriptors.notes:
Combat Violence
Intense battles against fantasy creatures (e.g., goblins)
Basic blood effects during weapon attacks
Non-realistic corpse remnants after enemy defeat
Excluded Content
No sexual content or implications
No sexual violence, drugs, or self-harm themes
No real-world religious/racial references

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit processor and operating system (Windows 10)
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual-Core (e.g. Intel Core i3-530 or AMD Phenom II X2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL 4.0 support (e.g. AMD Radeon HD 5770 or NVIDIA GeForce GT 430)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
